tldr: Global leaders gathered at the UN General Assembly, with discussions involving U.S. President Trump and China's Xi Jinping focusing on AI and technology transfer.
Concerns about artificial intelligence and its impact on humanity were raised by Pope Leo XIV during his visit to France, while the Australian government faced an AI-driven cyberattack.
US math and reading test scores have reached a 25-year low, with reports indicating that the agency responsible for collecting crucial data has been significantly impacted.

market.why: The S&P 500 closed lower, with the Nasdaq Composite seeing a slight gain, in a volatile trading session influenced by mixed economic data and ongoing global political developments.

yield_10y.why: Treasury yields rose as selling pressure intensified, driven by hawkish commentary from the Federal Reserve and stronger-than-expected economic data, contributing to a volatile week in the bond market.

vix.why: The VIX increased slightly, indicating a modest rise in market volatility amid ongoing global geopolitical discussions and mixed economic signals.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate saw an increase in the latest weekly survey, tracking a broader upward trend in Treasury yields over recent days, which some analysts suggest could push rates to 8% as economic outlook remains unclear.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

tech.summary: Sony and Universal Music Group have filed another lawsuit against Suno, alleging that its latest AI model still infringes on copyrights by being trained on outputs from previous models that used unlicensed music.

Microsoft is relaunching its Copilot app as a 'super app,' integrating chat, coding, and agent capabilities into a single interface to compete in the AI market, as it looks to find a successful AI strategy.
The Pentagon is requesting $30 million to develop an AI-powered lie detector system over the next five years, focusing on machine learning algorithms and 'standoff sensing' technology.

world.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has lifted restrictions on a controversial federal voter database, amid efforts by President Trump to implement tighter voting regulations ahead of the midterm elections, a move critics argue could disenfranchise eligible voters.

Iran has proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz and resuming nuclear talks within seven days, presenting a potential deal to President Trump ahead of U.S. midterm elections, which could involve difficult concessions.

Pope Leo XIV, during his first visit to France, cautioned against a 'paradise of machines' and warned that artificial intelligence could undermine humanity, emphasizing that technology must remain in service of humans.

Fighting has broken out in Ethiopia's Tigray region, leading to restricted internet access, a situation reminiscent of the complete external isolation experienced during the region's two-year civil war.

us.summary: U.S. math and reading scores have fallen to their lowest point in 25 years, and reports indicate that the National Center for Education Statistics, responsible for collecting critical data, has been significantly hindered.

The Supreme Court has allowed the use of an overhauled federal data system for citizenship checks, a system that has previously misidentified U.S. citizens and was found by a lower court to violate federal privacy protections.
Hurricane Nolo is projected to slow down as it approaches Hawaii's Big Island, potentially becoming a major hurricane and bringing heavy rainfall to areas that have experienced flooding this summer.

science.summary: A new analysis suggests that human actions, including deforestation and climate change, are contributing to a global increase in infectious disease outbreaks.
The NHS in England is implementing a policy to suspend staff suspected of improperly accessing patient records, following numerous instances of trust violations.
